verdict.rationale: Sierra offers adjacent tooling. Insights shows the knowledge sources behind every agent answer, Explorer answers natural-language questions across real conversations and sends weekly briefings on emerging issues with recommendations, and Agent Studio lets teams view and edit grounding knowledge. A support ops lead could use these to manually find where knowledge is causing misses, but nothing documents automatic surfacing of knowledge gaps or conflicting content. Missing for 10: explicit knowledge-gap detection (e.g. unanswered or low-confidence question reports tied to missing content), conflicting/contradictory content detection, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
